documents.source_title: Enterprise Laptop Keyboard & Keycap Service Guide
documents.author: iFixit / Enterprise Service Manuals (Dell & Lenovo)
documents.excerpt: Keyboard sticking or broken keycaps in enterprise modular chassis (ThinkPad T-series, Latitude 7000) are classified as Tier 1 minor repairs. Servicing involves either individual keycap scissor mechanism replacement (15 min labor) or complete modular keyboard drop-in assembly (30 min labor). Economic viability is high when replacement part cost is under 15% of residual asset value.

documents.source_title: Thermal Subsystem Servicing & Repasting Best Practices
documents.author: Hardware Maintenance Standard SOP-TH-04
documents.excerpt: Thermal throttling and fan noise in 3-5 year old laptops/desktops are predominantly caused by desiccated thermal interface material (TIM) and dust accumulation in the copper fin stack. Cleaning with compressed air and applying high-performance non-conductive thermal paste (e.g. Arctic MX-4) restores thermal headroom within 20-30 minutes, preventing processor degradation and thermal shutdowns.

documents.source_title: Lithium-Ion Battery Health Thresholds for Campus IT
documents.author: Battery University / IEEE 1625 Standard
documents.excerpt: Laptops with battery health remaining between 50% and 79% are suitable for general stationary campus use with intermittent mobility. Batteries exhibiting health below 50% or swelling must be retired immediately. Devices with degraded batteries can be safely converted into desk-bound workstations or upgraded with OEM replacement packs if the motherboard and display are pristine.

documents.source_title: Storage Subsystem SSD Upgrades for Legacy Hardware
documents.author: Crucial / Kingston Enterprise Lifecycle Extension Whitepaper
documents.excerpt: Replacing mechanical 5400/7200 RPM HDDs with SATA III or NVMe solid-state drives delivers a 4x-10x increase in random 4K I/O operations, rendering 6th-8th Gen Core i3/i5 systems fully responsive for modern web browsing, office suites, and lightweight programming environments.
